title: GovernanceOverride
description: Catalog-as-code shape of a governance override: the human control surface above the automated quality gate (architecture.instructions.md 'Human Override'). Narrows, downgrades, or disables an accepted rule at resource-group-equivalent scope or narrower - it never edits the rule. See docs/roadmap/rules-and-detection/rule-governance.md 'Overrides'. Loaded into fdai.rule_catalog.schema.override.Override.

target_rule.description: The rule this override narrows, downgrades, or disables.

scope.description: A scope:// address. MUST resolve to resource-group-equivalent or narrower (rejected at the domain-object boundary otherwise) - organization/account-wide is a rule retirement, not an override.

parameter_overrides.description: Widens a threshold within the range the rule's schema declares. Every key MUST also be allow-listed by the separately reviewed rule-catalog/override-parameter-bounds.yaml policy; an unlisted key or an out-of-bound value fails the catalog load closed (fdai.rule_catalog.schema.parameter_relaxation_policy).

requested_by.description: Entra OID of the requester. MUST differ from approver (no self-override).

approver.description: Entra OID of the override approver. MUST differ from requested_by.

expires_at.description: Optional - unlike an exemption, an override MAY be permanent.
